scopedValue.doNotConfuseWithAsAuthored: Finishing an entire mathematics curriculum before testing a narrow model hypothesis.
scopedValue.label: Mathematics needed to understand the chosen model
scopedValue.meaning: Existing preparation component, not a new course/exercise, prerequisite pass, employer curriculum or degree/experience substitute.
scopedValue.observableDepthAsAuthored: Demonstrate the mathematics needed by the selected task on a hand-checkable case: for example a linear solve/projection, loss/gradient, constrained optimum or mechanistic equation/event calculation, with dimensions and scaling explained. Add probability, uncertainty or calibration depth when the chosen model or measurement claim requires it; a deterministic numerical-software task does not automatically require empirical-ML calibration. Fresh evidence may establish existing depth.

scopedValue.label: Scientific measurement semantics and reference identity
scopedValue.meaning: Existing preparation component, not a new course/exercise, prerequisite pass, employer curriculum or degree/experience substitute.

t10.triton.policy.title: Triton policy and access
t10.triton.policy.body:
At commit 2122e24efc1886bfa36337c1f5b07c47d827b1d4, Triton commits to accepting functional fixes meeting quality standards with minimized regression tests; performance improvements generally qualify, but usefulness/complexity can justify rejection. Deep IR/API/pass designs are discretionary and expected rare.

Dated module/core/lead governance covers in-tree modules (05/12/2024), core maintainers (09/18/2026) and lead (05/12/2024), not out-of-tree modules (03/24/2026). Phil Tillet is the dated lead; employer, current appointment or availability is unverified.

Maintainers may defer review; prompt review is not guaranteed. The selected guide establishes no blanket AI rule. Public international routes are not personal inboxes, recruitment, funding/mentorship guarantees, private access or autonomous submission/hardware permission. Employment geography/work rights stay separate.

Compiler/interpreter/profiler/backend tasks differ. Compiler changes need C++/IR depth; performance needs authorised backend hardware and maintainer acceptance. These are curated entry gates, not assessed competence. Code capability/version/licence sources stay separate; host checks are not GPU performance. No allocation or paid receiver follows.

wwp.aifs.body: Retained sources describe AIFS Single/ENS v2 as operational from12May2026, using physics-based initial analyses. Comparisons must match the analysis cycle; matched50r1 experiments differ from prior-cycle evaluations. Predeployment scorecard dates do not establish historical user availability, and prototype50r1 analyses were unavailable to users. Global/proper scores do not establish local-event calibration, extreme-hazard performance or customer decision value. Legacy ENS-v1 chronology conflicts and mixed Single/ENS wording remain unresolved; no training reconstruction follows. The selected model card declares weights CC-BY4 and examples Apache2; data/dependency terms remain separate. No model run or immutable-weight verification was performed.
wwp.mos.title: IEM MOS: native baseline with availability and oracle gates
wwp.mos.body: The inspected MOS/MAV station archive supplies a useful ordinary operational baseline. Its source exposes runtime/ftime and dynamic all-null-column removal; pinning source does not freeze the database. runtime alone does not establish publication or receipt-time availability. ASOS source exposes p01i, not a direct p06i; reset/phase ambiguity prevents a naive six-hour sum being an automatic truth oracle. Point-response retrieval failed in this research, so actual fields, population, bytes and unauthenticated access remain unverified. No account/key workflow was described by the inspected docs; that is not a successful request. Historical replay needs an explicit availability assumption or archived issue evidence. No hiring or service entitlement follows.
wwp.battledim.title: BattLeDIM: useful benchmark, bounded transfer
wwp.battledim.body: v1: same-network historical2018/evaluation2019; unseen-utility generalization unestablished. Carried configuration uses the same sensor lists and four cross-year pipe IDs; persistent-leak design is a compatible explanation, not proof of improper leakage. Test labels now public; fresh held-out evaluation requires freezing. Metadata reports CC-BY4 data and separate EUPL code; selected-file grants and manifest/repository reconciliation remain unchecked. This pass inspected records/configuration without acquiring network, SCADA or label files. Benchmark identity does not establish field intervention rates, paying deployment, ROI or access to a utility.

framing.readerOpening: AI is becoming an industrial stack as well as a software stack. A useful preparation direction is to understand a real system deeply enough to specify correct outcomes, profile its limiting resource, use strong native tools, and fix a demonstrated residual. That is a conditional strategy to test, not a protected human niche or a2031job-count forecast.
